assertion_independence: No assertion compares a value against the same variable the test passed in without reddening on a code change: the three added tests redden when the plan argument is dropped (negative-control.log records exactly those three TypeError failures at the base revision). Their limit is elsewhere, named in the finding at tests/test_the_admission_service_holds_steady_memory.py:33: the stubbed ledger.load returns {"runs": []} whatever it is passed, so none of them fails if the store stops narrowing.

assertion_review.bound itself: No added assertion fails if ledger.load is handed the plan and returns the project's whole history, so the memory claim is carried by the recorded measurement rather than by a test.
assertion_review.per-plan cache key: Reverting the cache key to (key, project) serves plan-b from plan-a's entry and fails the recorded-call list at tests/test_the_admission_service_holds_steady_memory.py:43.
assertion_review.per-plan failure caching: Reverting the failure cache key to the project fails the two key lookups at tests/test_the_admission_service_holds_steady_memory.py:54-55.
assertion_review.plan argument forwarding: Reverting ledger.load(project, plan=plan) to ledger.load(project) leaves kwargs empty and fails the equality at tests/test_the_admission_service_holds_steady_memory.py:35.

findings.summary: the read narrows on ledger.row_plan's answer while the match at :614 prefers node.plan, so a ledger row whose node names the plan and whose row_plan names another or none matched before and is invisible now, and no test covers that equivalence.

the fixture stubs ledger.load to return {"runs": []} whatever it is passed, so the three added tests redden on removing the plan argument but stay green if the store stops narrowing its read, leaving the bound the goal names without a failing test.

decisions_steady is false on every home carrying history (profile-admission-livehome-100p.json has 13 digests, and cmp-3-head and cmp-3-base differ), so the done_when's equal-decisions half is demonstrated only on a fixture home.

the declared negative control is not reproduced because multipass-100-base.json gives growth_ratio 1.0173 against the required >1.2, and the substitute base arm is a three-pass peak comparison (cmp-3-base 4619415552 B against cmp-3-head 2009300992 B).
_Untraced reports peak, current and high as 0, so the multi-pass record's traced_peak_bytes 0 and empty largest_allocation_sites read the same as a single-pass run that traced no allocations.
